scoring_justification: Full MD simulation logs are large; recompute in verifier is infeasible. We compare the agent's computed aggregate results to the paper-reported ranges and threshold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ranges for heat capacity increase at 150 K and 300 K, and MSD mobility threshold.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'At 150 K ... 12–16% ... at 300 K ... only by 4–5% higher' and 'MSD >0.1 nm^2' for significant atomic rearrangement.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported quantitative ranges.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported target ranges; they bound the expected reproduction result.

outputs.description: Heat capacity increase of an ideal 6 nm Pd cluster relative to bulk Pd at 150 K and 300 K, computed from MD energy fluctuations.
Mean square displacement of a 6 nm Pd cluster containing 20% vacancies after MD simulation at 300 K, quantifying atomic mobility.

output_contract.notes: The bulk Pd heat capacity reference values are 15.6 J/(mol K) at 150 K and 25.9 J/(mol K) at 300 K. The agent uses these to compute the rise percent. No further gold values are provided.
